title: fix(ui): stop calling image-only tool results unavailable
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: opening a successful image-only tool result shows “Full output unavailable” and offers copy/download controls that export empty text.

## User Impact

User impact: complete non-text results no longer look broken. Tool input remains inspectable, and genuinely missing full output still preserves captured text and recovery guidance.

## Why This Change Was Made

A matched completed result is available even when it has no text. Only a missing matched result needs recovery; text exports require nonempty text. No new UI states or helpers.

## Evidence

Real Control UI with a synthetic, valid image-only MCP result. Red rectangles mark the false warning and empty export controls before, and the corresponding details area after.

**Before**

![Before: successful image-only result mislabeled unavailable](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f08b8f4c-6986-4e8b-9393-80bea7c2e0b7)

**After**

![After: complete non-text result without false recovery or empty export actions](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5eee907-e1d8-4651-a582-d4e27a217b9c)

- Regression fails on main and passes with the fix.
- Owning browser suite: 4 passed, including genuine unavailable/truncated-output recovery and exact exports. Owning unit suite: 19 passed. UI types, focused lint, formatting, and diff checks passed.
- Image-only MCP results are produced by the existing MCP content conversion. Original output recovery: #153542; Solid migration: #176599. Real recovery remains intact.
- Maintainer source/visual review completed. Current-head functional CI passed; the older cancelled auxiliary ClawSweeper dispatch was followed by a completed current-head review.

Requested and guided by @vyctorbrzezowski; implemented by RoboClaw.

## Work sessions

Linked for team reference; these sessions aren’t public.

- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/53cb60dd-b224-4e21-b03b-3e5042ea91f9)


## Maintainer preparation

Removed unconditional screenshot capture and file writes from the two new regression cases, including their unused imports. All navigation, assertions, existing opt-in proof support, and production behavior are unchanged. The edited test passes the scoped E2E typecheck, lint and formatting checks. Existing visual proof is reused; CI on the new published head will re-run the applicable behavior tests.
